claire: Quick heads-up: mobile SDK (iOS) streaming bug. On flaky LTE the stream sometimes delivers a final punctuation chunk before a preceding middle chunk. Happens ~1-2x / 1000 sessions. No error shown; app just renders weird text. :frowning:
max: is this EventSource or websocket or fetch? any repro in sampleapp?
claire: EventSource via our mobile wrapper. logs from the session:
```
[10:02:11] seq=1 text=\"hey\"
[10:02:14] seq=4 text=\".\"  <-- final punctuation arrives early
[10:02:18] seq=2 text=\", nice to\"
[10:02:19] seq=3 text=\" meet you\"
```
looks like seq numbers overlap across a reconnect.
erin: could be an auth refresh race. if token refresh triggers while the connection is draining the runtime might replay cached fragments and interleave with in-flight ones. do you see any token refresh logs around that time?
claire: yes we have an auth refresh at 10:02:13 in logs. SDK auto-retries but doesn't attach a resume token.
max: parity note: android SDK (okhttp) seems less affected, probably because our android SDK waits for drain before reconnect. iOS opens a new connection immediately during refresh.
erin: short-term mitigation: in mobile SDKs, gate reconnects during a token refresh and optionally buffer/until-seq to avoid interleaving. also add client-side reorder/dedupe if server emits a monotonic seq.
claire: can runtime include an `X-Chunk-Seq` header or SSE `id:` per event? that would make client reordering straightforward.
max: agree. also include `X-Stream-Session` so clients can detect when fragments belong to same logical stream across reconnects.
erin: we'll add a diagnostic counter in SDKs to emit an event when out-of-order or duplicate seq is detected so infra can alert if this spikes.
claire: i'll add a tiny sampleapp test that simulates token refresh during a throttled stream (nghttp2 proxy + forced token expiry). will paste commands.
infra-bot: created infra ticket #5334: \"streaming: add X-Chunk-Seq / X-Stream-Session and recommend client reorder/dedupe\" https://git.redwood/infra/issues/5334 :robot_face:
devx-bot: created SDK task #2147: \"mobile(iOS): hold reconnect during auth refresh + add reorder/dedupe option\" https://git.redwood/sdk/issues/2147 :robot_face:
claire: thanks — will push sampleapp repro and link both tickets. also will add a tiny unit in iOS SDK that simulates overlap and asserts reorder preserves seq. :thumbsup:
